{{Quote|His cousin escaped and took him to Zehava. He had a few peaceful years, but then the Daan attacked the Melida sector, and his cousin had to fight. She was seventeen, old enough then. She died, too. Nield was left on the streets to fend for himself. He was eight years old.|Cerasi, recounting Nield's childhood to Obi-Wan Kenobi|<ref name="JA" />}}
Around [[49 BBY/Legends|49 BBY]],<ref name="Date" /> a '''battle''' occurred in the [[City/Legends|city]] [[Zehava]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Melida/Daan/Legends|Melida/Daan]].<ref name="JA" /> One of the many conflicts<ref name="CSWE-Nield">{{CSWECite|II|378&ndash;379|Nield}}</ref> between the [[Melida/Daan Civil War|warring]] tribes of the [[Melida/Legends|Melida]] and [[Daan (people)/Legends|Daan]], the fighting began when the Daan launched an assault against the Melida sector of the city. The Daan [[Youngling/Legends|child]] [[Nield]] and his [[Nield's cousin|cousin]]&mdash;who had [[Battle of Nield's village|fled]] to Zehava previously after a conflict in their [[Nield's village|village]] were present, and the [[Gender/Legends|boy's]] cousin was forced to fight. However, the cousin was eventually [[Death/Legends|killed]] in the battle. The orphaned eight-[[Standard year/Legends|year]]-old Nield, left on the streets by himself, joined many of the planet's children in a group&mdash;[[the Young]]&mdash;to fight for peace on Melida/Daan.<ref name="JA" /> In [[44 BBY/Legends|44 BBY]],<ref name="Date" /> Nield's friend [[Cerasi]] recounted the struggles of the former's childhood, including the Zehava battle, to [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] during the Padawan's [[First mission to Melida/Daan|mission]] to the world.<ref name="JA" />

==Behind the scenes==
The battle was first mentioned in the [[1999]] young-readers book [[Jedi Apprentice: The Defenders of the Dead|''The Defenders of the Dead'']], which was written by [[Jude Watson]] as the fifth entry of the [[Star Wars: Jedi Apprentice|''Jedi Apprentice'']] series.<ref name="JA" />
